chunks: Whatever is in it from Isma'il al-Ju'fi, I have narrated it from Muhammad ibn 'Ali Majilawayh—may Allah be pleased with him—from his uncle Muhammad ibn Abi al-Qasim, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Sinan and Safwan ibn Yahya, from Isma'il ibn 'Abd al-Rahman al-Ju'fi al-Kufi.

key_terms.إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْ: A named transmitter from whom the narrations are ultimately reported
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates the author's act of narration

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain for narrations from Isma'il al-Ju'fi in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Isma'il ibn 'Abd al-Rahman al-Ju'fi al-Kufi. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission for hadith authentication and source tracing within the book.
